editorial:
Imagine losing your best friend and partner in a heartbeat, then suddenly becoming a dad to three little girls. That is the tough spot Artie Lewis finds himself in. You get a gritty mix of a crime thriller and a family drama as Artie tries to balance changing diapers with chasing down killers. It feels like those classic nineties police movies where one honest cop takes on a crooked system, and the stakes feel personal because he is not just fighting for the law, but for the kids who have nobody else.

You will love how the movie balances the heavy action with those sweet, funny moments between Artie and the girls. The pacing stays quick, and while some of the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the vibe perfectly. If you are into old-school revenge stories, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After a lot of fighting, Artie finally tracks down the crime lord responsible for his partner's death. In a big final showdown, Artie uses everything he has to take the bad guy down for good. He does not let the system fail him this time and ensures justice is served. The movie ends with Artie fully embracing his role as a father, showing that he has found a new purpose in life with the girls.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s cop movies and stories about found family.
